_comment: Hand-authored. export_data.py reads this and never writes it.
To add a topic: add an entry below. Nothing else needs changing - not the export
script, not the pages. Give it a 'sheet' only if a whole workbook sheet belongs to
it; a topic with no sheet is fine and simply picks up whatever rows name it in
id       used in web addresses and inside quadrants.json. Never change one that
is already published - links carry it.
title    the short name. Filter options, tags on a card, breadcrumbs.
heading  the longer phrasing, used only as the heading on this topic's own page.
sheet    the workbook sheet whose rows default to this topic when their Topics

topics.title: Health system impact
topics.heading: Prevention and the health system
topics.question: How do we show that prevention changes what happens in hospitals?
topics.blurb: Waiting lists, bed days, ambulance ramping and potentially preventable hospitalisations.

topics.title: Health inequities
topics.heading: Targeting prevention to reduce health inequities
topics.question: Where should prevention effort go, so the gap between groups narrows?
topics.blurb: Differences in health between population groups and between areas, and how they are measured.

topics.title: Local government measurement
topics.heading: A prevention measurement framework for local government
topics.question: How would a council know whether its area is getting healthier?
topics.blurb: Walkability, green space, food environment and participation, measured at council level.
